## Core Entity Details
- **Company Name:** Samarth Fire Protection System
- **Corporate Entity:** Registered Partnership & Registered MSME
- **Founder & Lead Consultant:** Sameer M. Kangutkar (Maharashtra Fire Services Licensed Agency Director)
- **Primary Business Focus:** Audit-led fire safety consultancy, system design, installation, troubleshooting, and compliance certification.

## State Government License (Authoritative)
- **License Number:** MFS/LA/RF-34/RD-35
- **Issuing Authority:** Directorate of Maharashtra Fire & Emergency Services, Government of Maharashtra
- **Valid Period:** 14 January 2026 to 13 January 2028
- **Licensed Scope (Class D Agency):**
  1. Fire Fighting and Sprinkler System — Class D
  2. Detection and Fire Suppression System — Class D
- **Compliance Mandate:** Authorized to issue Form A (on project completion) and Form B (six-monthly compliance checks, filed every January and July).
- *Note: License MFS/LA/F-620 printed in older brochures is outdated and replaced by MFS/LA/RF-34/RD-35.*

## Service Lines
1. **Fire Fighting Systems:** Wet riser hydrants, yard landing valves, jockey booster pumps, automated sprinkler networks, and hose reel fittings.
2. **Fire Detection & Alarm:** addressable and conventional smoke sensor loops, heat detectors, manual call points, speaker talkbacks, panel zone troubleshooting, and cable fault overrides.
3. **Extinguishing Equipment:** supply of DCP, CO₂, Foam, and Wet Chemical cylinders. Cylinder servicing, gas refilling, and Hydrostatic Pressure Testing (HPT).
4. **Passive Fire Protection:** installation of Fire-Rated Doors (FRD) with auto-closers, duct fire dampers, electrical shaft cable sealant sealing, and fire-resistant barrier coatings.
5. **Compliance & NOC:** physical safety assessments, C.F.O. liaison, Form A completion logs, and bi-annual Form B compliance filings.
6. **Training & Mock Drills:** society evacuation planning, hands-on extinguisher training, basic First Aid/CPR classes, and mechanical hydrant operation drills.
7. **Annual Maintenance (AMC):** preventative inspection, weekly booster pump testing, bi-annual line testing, panel calibration, and compliance reporting.

## Industry Landmarks & Facility Types Served
- Central Government Nuclear Facility Complexes
